'''Modules''' are items placed in the [[Relay Tower]] that are used to scan for specific types of [[Mobs|Parasites]] or info on a [[:Category:Systems|System]] depending on the ingredients used in creating the Module. After scanning a Module, a Relay Scan Report will be printed based on the scanned Module. In the case of the three System modules, Phase, Vector, and Dislodgement, the corresponding [[Module Reports|Module Report]] will be printed instead.

== ''Obtainment & Info'' ==
All modules require a [[Module Genic Receptacle]]/other Module(s) as well as several parts of parasites in that module tier.

The Phase Module is a System module that scans for the current [[Evolution Phases|Phase]] the world is in and information about that Phase. After scanning, it will give a [[Module Reports#Phase_Report|Phase Report]] that will display said info.

===''Vector Module''===
The Vector Module is a System module that scans for the current location and health of [[Emerging Infestation Vector|Emerging Infestation Vectors]] within a 5000x5000 block radius of the Relay Tower it is used on. When giving a scan report, it will give a [[Module Reports#Vector_Map|Vector Map]] that displays this info on the 5000x5000 grid.

===''Dislodgement Module''===
The Dislodgement Module is a System module that scans for any activations of the current [[Dislodgment System|Dislodgement Code]] and prints a [[Module Reports#Dislodgement_Report|Dislodgement Report]] with the Dimension, the code number, and the effect that the code triggered has.
